messages:
alex: Quick sync — experiment plan for week of May 8: combine free-credit gating + webinar + prompt templates to push activation. TL;DR: 3 arms, 2 routing paths, benchmark narrative to publish after run.

jess: outline?

alex: Arm A = 100 starter credits + 24h onboarding email sequence. Arm B = 100 credits + in-app prompt templates + micro nudges. Arm C = control (no extra credits). Primary metric = 7-day activation (first successful prompt that returns >20 tokens of useful content). Secondary = 14-day retention and cost per activated user.

omar: For the webinar piece, are we gating registration behind a small usage threshold or using credits as incentive?

alex: Thinking: invite users who hit 3 queries but haven't activated by day 3. Offer webinar seat + extra 50 credits after attending. Also route high-intent signups (>=10 queries in 72h) to SDR queue.

priya: Routing rules draft (pseudo):
```
if queries >= 10 within 72h: route -> sales_inbound_sdr
else if queries >=3 and activated == false and days_since_signup <= 7: invite -> webinar_registered_track
else if signup_day == 0: enroll -> onboarding_email_sequence
```

jess: Love the routing. Need to confirm data availability for "activated" flag in real time. Growth-bot, can you confirm event stream latency?

growth-bot: event-stream latency average 90s, 99th 6m. Real-time flags available for routing decisions in next-release branch.

omar: Webinar narrative: benchmark-first. We should show a short case study during the webinar: "3x faster prototyping with Redwood API + prompt templates" and a live demo of templates for customer support + summarization. Keep it 30 mins + 15 Q&A.

priya: Also propose a pre-webinar drip that surfaces prompt templates inside the app 48h before session to increase demo preparedness. That should lift attendance.

alex: Audience segmentation: new signups (0-7d), early power users (8-30d, 3-20 queries), and high-intent (>=20 queries). Different email copy per segment.

jess: A/B copy idea: "Get 100 credits to build your first feature" vs "Get curated prompt templates + 100 credits". We should measure activation by cohort and ad-hoc funnel events.

omar: Benchmarks to publish after: activation rate (7d), median time to first meaningful output, cost per activated user, webinar attendance rate, post-webinar activation lift. Draft numbers: baseline activation = 12% -> target +6-10pp on best arm.

priya: Experiment length: 3 weeks ramp + 2 weeks observation. Need tracking plan and GA/Amplitude events. I'll own the tracking doc.

alex: Can marketing ops set up the credit distribution and webhook for attendance -> credit top-up? Ops: @jess can you own the infra handshake with eng?

jess: I can. Need a small spec from eng for the promo code API. @omar can you provide the promo flow mock?

omar: Yup — will drop mocks by EOD Friday.

alex: Also final check on messaging: benchmark narrative headline options:
- "How teams cut dev time by 3x using prompt templates and Redwood inference"
- "From zero to feature: 100 credits + templates = shipped POC in a day"
Pick one to iterate.

priya: Prefer the first — more credibility.

jess: I'll set up the campaign in Marcom and schedule cohort sends. Also adding UTM tracking for each arm.

alex: Action items: Priya -> tracking doc + cohort mapping; Omar -> webinar mocks + demo scripts; Jess -> campaign + promo API handshake; Growth-bot -> flag availability verification. We'll reconvene Monday 10am to finalize. :thumbsup:

priya: noted.

jess: done.

omar: will have mocks.

growth-bot: flag check passed in staging yesterday.

alex: Great — thanks team.
